en: Now that ya mention it, you do.
Ya just haven't noticed. Maybe folks here are just used to it.
I don't think that's it. We'd have noticed based on our bra sizes.
Maybe so, yeah.
Then again, my chest is on the larger side, so I'm in no position to talk.
How'd they get that big, anyway?
How...? They just naturally are, I guess.
It's genetics.
Come to think of it, my mother and grandmother had big chests too!
Really? Maybe the women of Hokkaido just got that kinda body.
I think it's just my family.
Do they get massaged a lot? That's what I heard, that they get bigger when guys massage 'em.
Maybe that's true!
But I started getting bigger towards the end of elementary school, so I don't think that has much to do with it.
Ya sure were an early bloomer, huh?
It's 'cause ya drink milk. Milk's a big Hokkaido thing.
How does that logic work? If that were the case, every girl in Hokkaido would wind up being huge.
Ain't that exactly what I'm sayin'?
But there are girls with small chests at this club. I think you may not want to go around saying that sort of thing...
Uh. Sorry.

I hear eatin' curry soup for breakfast is a new diet.
Eating curry in the morning?
Yeah. The spices in the curry warm up the body and jump-start yer metabolism, I guess.
Eatin' it in the mornin' gets the body goin' better than if ya eat it before bed.
Wow! You know, I don't think I've ever eaten curry for breakfast.
Some spices are good for anti-agin' things and others help yer digestive system, so it's good for ya either way.
And I bet curry soup is light enough to eat right after waking up, too. I'll have to try it!
Oh, and curry also goes well with lamb barbecue!
Really? Doesn't seem like it would go well.
I don't mean the curry roux. I'm talking about sprinkling curry powder on it. I recommend it if you're tired of the normal sauce.
I'll give it a try.
Wait, hold on. You don't lose weight if you don't exercise as well, right?
All it does is make it easier to burn fat, so if ya don't exercise after it won't be as effective.
Aww. I wish there was a food that let me lose weight by just sitting around.
Sounds like a good way to gain weight.
Speaking of, the horoscope for Scorpios today said it was a bad day for health. Maybe I should track down some curry soup!
Yeah, that should make ya feel better.
Speaking of, that friend of mine who's getting divorced likes curry. It's been a while since we last ate together. Maybe I should fix that.
Sounds good. Ya gotta be nice to yer friends.
Saejima-san, we already talked about this.
Oh, did we?
I guess you're really interested in this topic.
Did ya know July is uni season?
Oh, really? I eat it all year round, though.
Different species can be caught at different times of year. July's when you can get short-spined uni. That's the tastiest.
Wow, I had no idea! I honestly thought all the uni they have around here was the same.
I heard early summer's the best time to eat uni in Sapporo. Ya want to get in on it before the tourists all swarm into town.
That reminds me. I hear Tokyo's the best place to go for sushi. Is that true?
Do they say that? How come?
Apparently fish from all over Japan is sent to the Tsukiji fish market. That's not fair!
I see. Well, if ya want fish from the cold northern waters, it's gonna be the freshest here in Hokkaido.
Speaking of, I was surprised to learn that calling it nama-zushi is a Hokkaido dialect thing.
What's nama-zushi? Fish in vinegar?
Here in Hokkaido, it's just what we call your typical nigiri-zushi.
So then what does sushi mean here?
Norimaki, or inarizushi.
Sounds confusin'.
It always feels like a pain to leave the house, so sometimes I get sushi delivered.
But what you've said makes me want to head to the market right now! I'll make a rice bowl with more uni than any restaurant could possibly serve!
Yer gonna buy freshly caught uni? Sounds real tasty.
You know, this business of lying about my age... You could call it a real catfish story.
But now I'd rather it be a sea urchin story!
...What're ya even talkin' about?
Oh, did we?
So, do ya know why white chocolate's white?
Is white chocolate even really chocolate though? They taste completely different.
They're made from the same stuff, but it's white 'cause they don't include the cocoa mass.
That's also why it ain't bitter. That and 'cause milk and sugar are mixed in.
Oh really? I'm a big chocoholic, but I never considered white chocolate to be chocolate. I'll have to do a little taste test sometime!
But since I spend so much time at home, eating chocolate will make me fat.
White chocolate has more calories than regular chocolate too.
Dang. Guess I'll have to pass then...
Oh, that reminds me! My lucky color today is white!
Heh. Maybe there's a connection there.
Maybe I'll buy some white chocolate on my way home from work!
You know what? Every year I send Valentine's chocolate to my favorite martial artist!
Would a martial artist even want somethin' that sweet? And don't they got a strict meal regimen?
Yeah, but this person loves super sweet things! I heard about it in an interview with him and thought I should send him something!
Ya really keep up to date with things.
That girl I was talking about before gave me a Valentine's chocolate.
I'd assumed it was a normal friendly exchange at the time, but looking back, I wonder if she went all-out and made it for me by hand.
What, you think she's been tryin' to make a move on ya this whole time?
Hot water bottles are sellin' big recently. I guess they're perfect for cold Hokkaido.
Hot water bottles? I'm not good with that sort of thing. It's a pain to prepare, and it's hard so it'll hurt if I trip.
Newer ones got fluffy covers that are supposed to make 'em feel real nice and cozy.
They come in different shapes so you can wrap it around yer neck or hang it on yer shoulder. Ya can even wear some of 'em like a shoe.
I had no idea! I'll try to find one online!
Speaking of which, when I stayed with my friend in Tokyo, I was shocked at how cold it was!
Tokyo was cold? How come?
My guess is the walls in Tokyo are thinner than the ones we have in Hokkaido.
I'm fine with a T-shirt at home in Hokkaido, but in Tokyo I needed to wear another layer.
I see. Come to think of it, the thickness of the prison walls were different in Hokkaido than in Okinawa.
We've been getting a lot more convenient tech like that recently. It makes my life as a shut-in much better!
Maybe all these conveniences aren't so good...
I use my cell phone a lot when it's cold too.
Yeah? Why's that?
The longer I use the phone, the warmer the phone gets. Then I stick it in my pocket as a sort of makeshift pocket heater!
Yer a real piece a' work, ya know.
And hey, if you're cold, just cozy up with a girl and she'll warm you right up!
Well, the human body runs at 36.7 degrees Celsius. That's sorta like a hot water bottle.
Maybe I'll get my friend to come stay at my place, just for the winter. Hehe!
Maybe don't mention that to her...
I hear that in Hokkaido ya eat yer traditional New Year's meal on New Year's Eve. That true?
It is. In mainland Japan, I hear you wait until the actual new year starts before you eat it.
Yeah. On New Year's Eve, we traditionally eat soba noodles.
We eat that too. But New Year's Eve is an even more extravagant feast than Christmas for us!
Wow. I guess since ya got the bounty of the sea up here it's tastier than down in Tokyo.
Doesn't each part of the country have its own unique New Year's food? I hadn't thought about it before, but in Hokkaido it's really delicious!
I only worked in Tokyo for a little bit, but I still got hit with some major culture shock while I was down there!
Hm. Like what?
Oh, that's right! I saw my first cockroach! It skittered out from behind the refrigerator in the club's kitchen!
That's shockin' for lotsa reasons actually...
When I was in college, I made sure to get together with friends for a New Year's Eve party every year!
Sounds like a good time. Maybe I oughta do somethin' like that to ring in the new year...
It is! I never bother doing a New Year's shrine visit. Instead I celebrate by eating and drinking and then lounging around the house.
So I always gain weight in early January.
Then just get out more...
I guess if I get married, I'll have no choice but to prepare the New Year's meal.
Makin' it all from scratch is a big pain. Just get a premade one from the store.
But ordering it is a pain too... Would it be okay if I just went to a convenience store?
Why're ya askin' me?

So, whaddya like?
Hm? What do I like in terms of what?
Do ya got any favorite foods ya like to eat?
Oh, I like a lot of things.
Any food in particular ya like?
I'm a big fan of uni!
Uni, huh? Hokkaido's got plenty of seafood. Do ya eat sushi a lot?
Sushi's good, but I really like rice bowls with uni! Nothing beats a bowl of white rice topped with a ton of sea urchin!
Yeah, that sounds pretty good. You Hokkaido folks got good taste.
How 'bout alcohol?
Wine. Especially red.
Red wine, huh? Ya drink that a lot?
Oh yeah. Sometimes I drink until I drop! Most of the time I don't remember anything that happens though.
Yeah? I can see ya doin' that.
What kinds of TV do ya watch?
Martial arts shows, of course! Waking up to the sound of that gong gets me all rarin' to go for another new day!
They don't show martial arts stuff in the mornin', do they?
It's recorded, of course! I'll watch matches I like over and over again!
Yer kinda obsessed, huh?
Is there anythin' ya want right now?
Are you asking about Christmas presents?
I'm just askin' to ask.
Oh, you know what I want? A smartphone!
A smartphone? Ain't those just regular phones? Ya already got a cell phone, right?
No, they're even better! I see our customers tap-tapping away all the time, and it makes me really want one.
I can barely manage a normal phone. I think all that other crap would make it even harder for me to use.
I'd probably find it fun at first myself, and then get bored really quick. I don't use my phone that much to begin with.
Ya oughta get somethin' else then.
What sorta hobbies ya got?
Hmm... Lounging around the house, I suppose!
Lounging around and doin' what? Watchin' TV and stuff?
I guess I play with my cats a bit. And I watch movies, when I feel like it.
What kinda cats?
A white one and a black one, both female.
Two, huh? Must be a handful.
Hehe. When I'm in bed, they'll climb up onto my belly and have themselves a snooze!
I wish they wouldn't dump their weight on me like that, but they're so cute I don't mind letting them sleep with me.
Is sleepin' all ya ever do?
Don't ya go to movie theaters?
No. I don't leave the house much in general.
But don't ya still gotta leave the house to rent movies?
Oh, I just watch digital downloads, from the internet. You pay once and can watch as many as you want, for a whole week!
Wow, they got services like that now? Times really have changed.
It's also handy because there's no late fees for forgetting to return anything!
That ain't a hobby. There's gotta be somethin' ya do while yer indoors.
Hmm... I guess I write a blog.
Oh? Whaddya write about?
Just stuff like, "Hey, I'm at work today!"
I wouldn't of guessed. I thought you were lazier than that.
Yeah, but if I don't update it my manager gets mad. Since it's a pain to think of what to write, I usually just upload photos from my phone.
Sounds like yer really into it.
I'd rather not post pictures of myself on a webpage like that, but if I don't nobody will request me.
Guess yer workin' hard after all.
But that's for work! That ain't a hobby.
What? Okay, then... How about drinking?
But ya drink at work, too.
When my shift is over, I go out to drink at bars sometimes! One of my friends works at a girls' bar.
A girls' bar? Those're the ones with female bartenders, right? That's kinda like a cabaret club. Why woulda girl wanna go to one?
Female customers don't have to pay a cover charge. It's a better deal than a normal bar!
